channel.title: Fred Francis 2028 Campaign Updates
channel.description: Latest news and updates from the Fred Francis 2028 presidential campaign.

item.title: Campaign website rebuilt and relaunched
item.description: The Fred Francis 2028 campaign site has been rebuilt as a fast, fully indexable website with real pages for every issue, an accountability framework, and a way to make your voice heard on every proposal.

item.title: New issue: AI -- Learning to Manage a Novel, Useful Tool
item.description: A federally coordinated research effort -- NIST, NASA, DARPA, and the NTSB, working with industry standards bodies like ASME, IEEE, and JEDEC -- to characterize non-deterministic AI and make real applicability recommendations, built on existing federal precedent rather than starting from scratch.

item.title: Meet the candidate
item.description: Fred Francis now has a face on the front page. Come see who's running.

item.title: AI Issue updated: NSPM-11 and 101st Airborne field results
item.description: The AI issue page now incorporates the White House's June 2026 National Security Presidential Memorandum on AI in the national security enterprise, and real-world findings from the 101st Airborne Division's year-long AI integration effort -- including where AI works and where it doesn't.

item.title: New issue: AI Disinformation -- Securing the Instruments of Truth
item.description: The real disinformation threat is not the fakes we can see -- it is the corruption of the AI systems we rely on to tell real from fake. Training data provenance requirements for federal procurement, adversarial red-team protocols, a public model-integrity registry modeled on the CVE database, and allied coordination -- grounded in the 2026 Iran conflict evidence and peer-reviewed research.

item.title: Speeches page updated with candidate portrait
item.description: The Speeches page now features a portrait of Fred Francis -- putting a face to the words.

item.title: Site-wide SEO and discoverability overhaul
item.description: Schema.org structured data added to every page, Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags for social sharing, favicons, canonical URLs, sitemap improvements, volunteer positions posted, and Wikipedia links added to all Endorsements entries.

item.title: Accessibility, design fixes, and endorsements update
item.description: Accessibility improvements site-wide: skip-to-content links, keyboard focus indicators, and ARIA labels. Issue card design fixed for cross-browser compatibility. Endorsements updated to respect federal election law restrictions on 501(c)(3) organizations, with an explanatory note added. Punctuation normalized across all 30 pages.

item.title: Healthcare issue revised: five-statute reform with 38 verified sources
item.description: The healthcare issue page has been rebuilt from scratch. The problem extends beyond the HMO Act to include ERISA, HITECH, MACRA, and an unregulated prior authorization system. All claims now backed by 38 IEEE-cited references; the original version is preserved for transparency.

item.title: NAFTA issue page: full research paper with 45 IEEE-cited references
item.description: The NAFTA issue page now includes Key Points, a plain-language summary, and the complete Deeper Dive with full Accountability Framework. The companion research paper, "Good for No Worker," documents the full evidentiary record across 45 references.

item.title: Skilled Trades: six proposals including National Workforce Needs Commission
item.description: Complete rewrite of the skilled trades issue page with verified data, six policy proposals, Key Points, plain-language summary, and full Accountability Framework. The sixth proposal establishes a National Workforce Needs Commission housed within DOL's Employment and Training Administration.
